budgets.highlights: Rs 2 crore allocated per ward; TDP corporators boycotted the session; state audit objections cited over 1,407 items worth Rs 77 crore. A separate figure of Rs 5,614 crore circulated on social media; the press-reported approved estimate is Rs 5,457 crore.

budgets.presented_by: GVMC Council (Mayor Golagani Hari Venkata Kumari, YSRCP)
budgets.highlights: Capped at Rs 4,300 crore; opening balance Rs 480 crore, closing balance Rs 239 crore.
